chapters.aura: Your aura is tall-tree energy. Before you speak, people sense direction: this person knows where they're going and probably has a plan for getting there. Gap carries a clean, upright presence that reads as dependable and a little bit in charge. It's the aura of the friend everyone calls when the group trip falls apart. There's warmth in it, but it's structured warmth, like shade from a big tree on a hot day. Your glow isn't sparkle. It's steadiness that slowly makes people feel safer. When you're at your best, you look like someone who has grown into exactly the right shape. The glow-up for you isn't becoming someone softer or flashier. It's letting that natural backbone show without apologizing for how much space it takes.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: capable, serious, slightly intimidating. Strangers assume you're older or more senior than you are, and they often ask you for directions, advice or the wifi password. That's the tree effect. Second impression, once they know you: loyal, funny in a dry way, surprisingly sentimental about old photos. The gap between the two is where people get you wrong. Some think you're judging them when you're just concentrating. Your resting expression says "I'm handling it," which is great at work and less great at a party where you'd like someone to come talk to you. A small change helps: an open posture, a smile that arrives a second earlier, a question instead of a solution. People don't need you to be less strong. They need a door into the warmth.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is Wood: forest green, moss, sage, deep teal. These read as calm authority on you, like you were born wearing them. Water colours support you beautifully too, because Water feeds Wood in the five elements: navy, ink blue, charcoal. A navy coat over a green knit is basically your signature. For a lift, add a little Fire: a terracotta scarf, a rust bag, a coral lip. It warms up your serious energy and makes you look more approachable in photos. Go easy on heavy, cold metallics head to toe. Too much silver and stark white can make your aura read rigid rather than strong. Natural textures matter as much as colour for you: linen, wool, wood beads, anything that looks like it grew somewhere.
chapters.style: Your style is grounded classic with a long silhouette. Think structured blazers, straight-leg trousers, long coats, clean shirts, boots you could actually walk in. You look best in pieces with clear lines that echo your upright energy, nothing fussy, nothing that looks like it's trying too hard. Quality over quantity suits you; one good bag beats five trendy ones. Where you can play: one unexpected detail per outfit. A vintage brooch, a patterned sock, a bold earring. It hints at the funny, sentimental person underneath the competence. Hair and makeup lean natural and polished rather than dramatic. Your best "glow-up photo" is outdoors, in daylight, near trees or old architecture, standing tall, looking slightly off-camera like you just remembered something good.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the gentle leader. Same backbone, softer edges. The shift isn't in your clothes so much as your energy: asking instead of announcing, laughing at yourself more, letting other people take the lead on small things. Picture a K-drama CEO character in episode twelve, after they've learned to be kind. That's your arc. Try a few experiments. Compliment someone without adding advice. Wear something soft, like a cashmere knit or a flowy shirt, on a day you feel strong. Post a photo where you're laughing instead of composed. Make one decision just because it's fun, not because it's correct. Your aura gets warmer every time you show that strength and playfulness can live in the same person.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you're overextended, carrying everyone's plans and nobody's carrying yours. It shows as stiffness: shorter replies, a tense jaw, outfits that drift into the same grey uniform because deciding anything else feels like too much. You start looking efficient instead of alive. The reset for you is growth in small form. Go somewhere green and walk without a destination. Learn something useless and fun. Put on the green thing you love and leave the laptop closed for an evening. Rearrange one corner of your room so it feels new. And say no to one request this week, without a long explanation. Trees grow best with space around them. When you give yourself some, the glow comes back on its own.

chapters.aura: Your aura is a wildflower growing through a crack in the pavement: lovely, adaptable and much tougher than it looks. Eul has a soft, approachable glow that makes people want to talk to you. You read as friendly, creative and easy to be around, the person strangers ask to take their photo because you look like you'd make them look good. There's movement in your energy, a lightness that changes shape depending on the room. That's your gift and your challenge. Your glow is at its brightest when it's clearly yours, not borrowed from whoever you're with. The glow-up for you is deepening the colour of that flower, so people remember not just that you were lovely, but exactly who you were.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: sweet, warm, maybe a little younger than you are. People feel comfortable around you almost instantly, and they often tell you things they didn't plan to share. The risk is being underestimated. Some people read your gentleness as softness, then are surprised when you quietly get exactly what you wanted. Others think you agree with everyone, because you're so good at seeing all sides. What people miss is how resilient you are. Vines survive storms that snap trees. To be read more accurately, let your opinions show early. Disagree once in a conversation, kindly. Wear something that signals taste, not just niceness. You don't need to lose your warmth to be taken seriously. You just need a few more clear lines in the picture.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is soft Wood: sage, mint, pistachio, leafy green, a little olive. These look effortless on you, like you stepped out of a garden café. Water supports you, so soft blues, denim and misty grey work well as base colours. For charm and visibility, add a touch of Fire: blush, peach, soft coral, petal pink. That combination, green with a little pink, is pure flower energy and looks wonderful in photos. You can wear florals and prints better than most souls, especially small, delicate ones. Avoid looking washed out in head-to-toe beige or harsh, heavy black without a soft accent. You do best in colours that look alive, like they're still growing.
chapters.style: Your style is soft romantic with an artsy edge. Flowy midi skirts, cardigans, oversized shirts, ribbon details, little jewellery pieces you collect over time. You look great in layers and textures, especially when they move as you walk. Mixing vintage finds with simple basics feels very you. The trap is wearing whatever your friends or partner like, until your closet looks like five different people. Choose a signature: maybe it's always a hair clip, a particular perfume, a silver ring stack, a certain shade of green. One consistent detail makes your style recognizable without losing flexibility. Hair with gentle texture or a soft accessory suits your movement. Your best photo spot is somewhere with flowers, plants or soft window light, mid-laugh, slightly turned.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is soft but certain. Picture a webtoon heroine who seems sweet in chapter one and turns out to be the most quietly unstoppable person in the story. The shift for you is self-definition. Say what you like, out loud, often. Order first at dinner. Keep your style choices even when someone teases them. Small acts like this make your aura go from pretty to unforgettable. Also try making things: arranging flowers, styling a shelf, curating a playlist for no one in particular. Your creativity shows on you. Keep your gentleness, it's genuinely magnetic. Just let people feel the stem beneath the petals, the part of you that keeps growing no matter what gets in the way.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you've been bending for too long. You start to look tired from people-pleasing: the smile is still there, but it's on autopilot. Your style gets vague too, borrowed outfits, safe neutrals, nothing that says you. That's the sign you've been living around other people's preferences. The reset is reclaiming your space. Spend an afternoon alone doing exactly what you want, no compromise. Wear your favourite colour even if it doesn't match anything. Rearrange your room, buy yourself flowers, play the music you secretly love. Text one friend who makes you laugh without needing anything from you. Vines are strongest when they're reaching toward light they've chosen, not just clinging to the nearest wall.

chapters.aura: Your aura is pure sunlight. Byeong walks in and the temperature rises, in the best way. People notice you even when you're not trying, and honestly, you're often trying a little. You radiate optimism, generosity and that "let's do something fun" energy that makes a boring night instantly better. Your glow is wide and open; it touches everyone in the room. That's why you're photographed at every party and remembered by people you met once. The glow-up for you isn't getting brighter. You're already very bright. It's learning to shine with depth, so people don't just see your warmth, they feel how genuine it is. Think golden hour rather than noon: the same sun, but richer, softer and far more beautiful to look at.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: confident, fun, easy to approach, maybe a little loud. People assume you're an extrovert with a hundred friends, and they're not entirely wrong. They feel included around you, which is a rare gift. The misreading comes from that same brightness. Some people think you're shallow because you're so cheerful, or that you need attention because you're so visible. They don't see how much you actually care, or how hurt you get when your effort goes unnoticed. To be read more fully, let a little quiet into your presence. Listen for longer. Share one serious thought among the jokes. Your sunny aura doesn't need dimming. It just becomes more trustworthy when people see that it's real all the way through.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is bright Fire: red, coral, tomato, warm orange, magenta. You can wear bold colour like almost nobody else, and it looks natural, not costume-like. Wood feeds Fire, so greens are a strong support: an emerald dress, an olive jacket, a green accessory against warm tones. For balance, Earth tones like camel, sand and mustard calm the sunshine into golden hour, which is gorgeous on you. Gold jewellery generally beats silver for your vibe. Be a bit careful with all-black, all-the-time. It can make your naturally warm energy look tired. If you love black, add a red lip, a coloured bag or a bright shoe so the fire still has somewhere to show.
chapters.style: Your style is bold, warm and joyful. Statement pieces, colour blocking, big earrings, a great jacket you get complimented on everywhere. Prints work for you, especially larger, confident ones. You suit outfits that move and catch light: satin, gloss, metallic thread, a little shimmer. The trap is going so loud that the outfit wears you. Pick one star per look: either the colour, the print or the accessory, and let the rest support it. Hair with volume and shine fits your energy. Your best photo is in direct golden-hour light, mid-laugh, looking straight at the camera, because you have the rare quality of looking even better when you're having fun. Never let anyone talk you into "toning it down" to fit in. Just edit it.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the warm host with depth. Imagine the K-drama character who's the life of every party, then one quiet episode reveals how much they've been holding together for everyone. That depth is your new layer. Try a few shifts. Spend some time listening instead of telling. Keep one plan small and intimate instead of big and public. Post fewer stories and more meaningful moments. Let one close friend see you on a cloudy day. None of this makes you less fun. It makes your fun feel safe to be around. People trust a sun that also knows how to set. You'll notice your aura reading as warmer, more grown-up and much more magnetic.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you're running on empty but still performing. You keep showing up, smiling and making the jokes, but there's a flatness behind it that close friends notice. Your outfits might get louder to compensate, or you might stop caring and fall into the same tired hoodie for days. Either way, the fire is flickering. The reset is genuine joy, not performed joy. Dance in your room to embarrassing music. Spend time in actual sunlight, outdoors, without your phone. Do something creative where no one's watching, cook a ridiculous meal, paint badly, sing loudly. Say no to one social plan and don't explain. Rest isn't the opposite of shining. It's what makes tomorrow's sunrise possible.

chapters.aura: Your aura is candlelight. Not the stadium spotlight, the soft glow that makes a small room feel intimate and safe. Jeong carries a warm, focused, slightly mysterious energy. People feel drawn closer to you, often without knowing why, and once they're near, they feel understood. You have the kind of presence that makes strangers confide in you at a party at 1am. Your glow is detailed and personal: a thoughtful look, a perfect question, the feeling that you're truly paying attention. The glow-up for you isn't becoming louder to compete with brighter people. It's trusting that your quiet flame is magnetic exactly as it is, and letting more people see it instead of saving it only for a few.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: gentle, thoughtful, a little reserved. Some people think you're shy. Others sense there's a lot going on behind your eyes and get curious. You often come across as kind, artistic and emotionally intelligent, the person who remembers small details and asks the right follow-up question. The misreading: people can think you're cold or uninterested when you're actually just warming up. Candles take a moment to catch. You may also hide your intensity, so people underestimate how passionate you are about the things you love. To be read more clearly, let your warmth arrive a little earlier. Offer a compliment, share an opinion with feeling, laugh openly. People will realize the flame was there all along.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is soft, glowing Fire: rose, dusty pink, berry, wine, plum and warm lilac. These colours feel intimate and romantic on you, like candlelight on silk. Wood feeds your Fire, so deep green and olive make a beautiful pairing, especially in velvet or knit. Warm neutrals like cream, latte and soft camel keep your look cosy and refined. Add small touches of gold to catch the light, a thin chain, small hoops, a ring. Avoid colours that feel too harsh or neon for you, like electric blue or acid yellow in large amounts. They can drown your subtle glow. Your colours should feel like the inside of a favourite café on a winter evening.
chapters.style: Your style is romantic and detailed. Delicate jewellery, soft knits, silk blouses, lace edges, pieces with small, interesting details that people only notice up close. That's the point, your style rewards attention, just like you do. Vintage pieces with stories suit you deeply. You also look stunning in candlelit textures: velvet, satin, cashmere. Keep silhouettes soft rather than sharp. The trap is being so subtle that your style disappears in a crowd. Add one focal point: a beautiful earring, a deep lip, a meaningful necklace. Hair soft and touchable, makeup glowing rather than dramatic. Your best photo is in warm, low light, close-up, with a small smile, looking like you know a secret.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the warm mystery who lets people in. Think of the quiet second lead in a webtoon, the one readers end up loving most, because their depth is real. The shift for you is visibility. Share your passions, the books, the music, the strange niche hobby, with people who aren't already your closest friends. Speak first sometimes. Wear the bolder lipstick on an ordinary day. Your intensity is attractive when it's expressed, not hidden. Also lean into creativity. Writing, photography, cooking, anything that lets the flame make something. People are drawn to someone who glows from the inside, and you've always had that. Now let it be seen from across the room.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you've been giving warmth to everyone and not keeping any for yourself. You might look tired, withdrawn, a little hidden behind oversized sweaters and a phone screen. You start overthinking every interaction and saying less. Your glow feels flickery, like a candle in a draft. The reset is creating a small, cosy world just for you. An evening with good tea, a lit candle, a book, no messages. A long, quiet walk with your favourite album. Writing down what's been weighing on you. Seeing one friend who makes you feel completely safe. Then return to the world in something soft and beautiful. Your flame doesn't need more fuel from others. It needs protection from the wind.

chapters.aura: Your aura is a mountain at sunrise: solid, calm and quietly impressive. Mu carries grounded, unhurried energy that makes people relax. In a chaotic room, you're the one who looks like nothing could knock you over, and people instinctively stand near you. You read as trustworthy, mature and reliable, the friend who'll still be here in ten years. Your glow isn't flashy. It's presence. You don't need to fill silence, and that confidence is magnetic in a world of over-talkers. The glow-up for you is letting people see the warmth and humour that live inside the mountain. Think of sunlight hitting the peak: the same rock, suddenly golden and beautiful to look at.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: calm, strong, maybe hard to read. People often assume you're very serious or unimpressed, because your expression doesn't move much. Some find you comforting, others find you intimidating. Once they know you, they discover your dry humour, your protective loyalty and how much you notice. The misreading comes from your stillness. You might seem uninterested in a conversation you're actually enjoying, or detached at an event you're secretly having fun at. A few small changes help people read you right: smile with your eyes when someone talks to you, nod more, share a quick reaction instead of waiting for the perfect one. Mountains don't need to move. They just need a path so people can climb up and enjoy the view.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is warm Earth: sand, camel, ochre, terracotta, chocolate, olive. These make you look rich, grounded and expensive in a quiet way, like a well-made leather bag. Fire supports Earth in the five elements, so warm reds, rust and burnt orange add life to your look. A rust sweater with camel trousers is basically your aura in an outfit. Cream and ivory freshen you up beautifully. Gold suits you more than silver. Be careful with all-grey or dull, muddy outfits with no contrast, because they can make your strong presence look heavy. Add one warm colour or a crisp cream piece to keep the mountain sunlit instead of foggy.
chapters.style: Your style is relaxed luxury. Quality fabrics, structured but comfortable pieces, outerwear that looks like it'll last twenty years. Think wool coats, chunky knits, tailored trousers, leather boots, a great watch. You suit an elevated basics wardrobe: few pieces, all excellent. Clean, solid silhouettes reflect your stable energy beautifully. The trap is defaulting to comfort so completely that you stop caring how you look. "Practical" can slide into "invisible." Choose one piece per outfit that feels a little special: a silk scarf, a textured jacket, a bold ring. Hair neat and natural, grooming polished and simple. Your best photo is outdoors in warm light, relaxed and grounded, with a real, slightly crooked smile that shows your humour.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the warm protector. Imagine the steady K-drama character who barely speaks, then cracks one perfect joke and the whole cast falls a little in love. That's you, with the joke said a bit more often. The shift for you is playfulness. Try new things deliberately: a new café, a dance class, a different style of jacket. Let people see you being silly. Share your opinions a little sooner and with more feeling. You don't need to become chatty or loud. Your calm is your power. But a mountain with wildflowers on it is more inviting than bare rock. Let your aura carry some colour, some lightness and some open invitations for people to come closer.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you get stuck. Same routine, same clothes, same evenings on the sofa, until your calm turns into heaviness. You don't look stressed exactly, you look stagnant, like a field nobody has planted in a while. People might notice you've gone quieter than usual. The reset for you is gentle movement and newness. Walk a route you've never taken. Rearrange a room. Cook a recipe from a cuisine you've never tried. Wear the warm colour you usually save for special occasions. Book one small plan that's purely fun, not useful. Clear out a drawer. Mountains are meant to be stable, not frozen. A little change on the surface keeps the whole landscape alive and glowing.

chapters.aura: Your aura is a garden in late spring: warm, welcoming and quietly abundant. Gi has a nurturing, soft-focus presence that makes people feel at home within minutes. You read as kind, thoughtful and genuinely interested, the person who notices someone standing alone at a party and goes over. Your glow is generous and practical, the comfort of good food and a well-lit kitchen. People feel better after spending time with you, even if they can't explain why. The glow-up for you isn't becoming more striking or dramatic. It's letting your own needs and taste take up as much room as your care for others. When you tend to yourself as well as you tend to everyone else, the whole garden blooms.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: friendly, approachable, a bit modest. People assume you're the reliable one, the friend who'll remember birthdays, and they're right. You rarely come across as intimidating, which means people open up to you fast. The misreading: they might think you don't have strong opinions, or that you're happy to go along with anything. In reality, you have very clear ideas, you just rarely push them. You can also be read as less ambitious than you are, because you don't advertise your goals. To be read more accurately, speak about what you want, not just what others need. Wear something with a bit of personality. Let your humour come out early. Gentle and powerful are not opposites. You're both.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is soft Earth: oatmeal, cream, honey, butter yellow, warm taupe, caramel. These feel natural and comforting on you, like freshly baked bread in colour form. Fire nourishes Earth, so soft warm tones like peach, apricot and dusty rose add a lovely glow, especially near your face. Muted greens like sage and olive feel garden-fresh against your neutrals. For jewellery, warm gold, pearls and soft ceramic or wooden pieces suit your energy. Avoid too much cold, stark colour, like icy grey or harsh black and white contrast, which can make your warm presence read flat. Your best palette looks like a sunlit kitchen with flowers on the table.
chapters.style: Your style is cosy refined. Soft knits, relaxed trousers, comfortable dresses, cardigans with good buttons, a great tote bag that holds everything. You look your best when you look comfortable and cared for at the same time. Natural fabrics like cotton, linen and wool suit you. The trap is dressing purely for function: whatever's easy, whatever's clean, whatever keeps you invisible so the attention stays on others. Try building a few "you" pieces into your rotation, a printed blouse, a beautiful scarf, earrings that make you smile. Hair soft and touchable, makeup fresh and warm. Your best photo is at a café table or at a picnic, holding something you made or chose, smiling at the person behind the camera.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the nurturer who also takes up space. Think of the comforting best friend in a K-drama who finally gets her own storyline and turns out to be the most interesting character. The shift for you is self-priority. Say what you want, not just what would be easiest for everyone. Take compliments without immediately deflecting. Spend money on something just for you, not useful, just lovely. Book the plan you've been suggesting for months and invite people to join you. Your warmth is magnetic. When you add confidence and a clear sense of your own taste, people start seeing you not just as the kind one, but as someone they genuinely want to impress.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you're over-giving. You look tired, scattered and a little overlooked. Your style slides into whatever's clean, your voice gets quieter in group conversations, and your worries start showing on your face as a permanent slight frown. You're tending everyone else's garden and letting yours grow weeds. The reset is gentle self-care that's actually about you. Cook a meal only you love. Spend an afternoon alone without errands. Buy yourself flowers, wear the soft colour that makes you feel pretty, write down three things you want this month. Hand one responsibility back to someone else. A garden doesn't bloom by giving all its soil away. Keep some for yourself.

panels.text: Gi, your aura is a garden. People feel at home with you in five minutes.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Because you've already fed them, found them a charger and asked about their mum.

You read as confident, decisive and a little bit fearless, the person who would handle the emergency while everyone else is still panicking. Your glow is bold and uncompromising. Some people find it thrilling, others find it intimidating, and both reactions are a sign of power. There's also an unexpected loyalty in your energy, a protective edge that makes the right people feel completely safe. The glow-up for you isn't becoming softer to be liked. It's adding warmth so the strength reads as protective rather than cutting, a blade in a velvet sheath.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: strong, blunt, maybe intimidating. People assume you're tough, confident and not easily impressed, and they often hesitate before approaching. Once they know you, they find a fiercely loyal friend with surprising sentimentality and a strong sense of justice. The misreading comes from your directness. Earth supports Metal in the five elements, so camel, sand and taupe add warmth and approachability without losing strength. A camel coat over a white shirt is your aura in its best form. chapters.style: Your style is sharp minimalism. Tailored blazers, crisp shirts, structured coats, straight-leg trousers, clean sneakers or sleek boots. Your best photo is in strong, clear light, urban backdrop, facing the camera directly with a slight, confident smile. You don't need to pose. You just need to let your presence speak.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the protector with a soft heart. Picture the cold, competent K-drama lead who is secretly the warmest person in the story. Your evolution is showing that warmth sooner. Try saying the kind thing first, before the critique. Ask questions instead of giving verdicts. Let someone else win an argument that doesn't matter. Show your sentimental side, keep the ticket stub, frame the photo, tell people they matter. Wear something unexpectedly soft. These shifts don't weaken you. They make your strength trustworthy. People will still respect you, but they'll also feel safe approaching you, and that's when your aura becomes truly magnetic instead of just impressive.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you're battle-worn. You've been fighting too many fights, at work, in your head, on behalf of other people, and your edge turns brittle. You look tense, sound clipped and might snap at small things. Your style can become harsh and rigid too: all black, all armour, no softness anywhere. The reset is putting the sword down for a while. Do something physical and simple, like a long walk or cleaning out a cupboard. Spend time with someone who makes you laugh and needs nothing from you. Wear something soft and comfortable. Clear your space, because clutter bothers you more than most souls. Let one problem stay unsolved for a day. Even the strongest blade needs time in its sheath.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Gyeong, your aura is a sword. Strong, clean, people trust you in a crisis.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: They also hesitate before saying hello. You look like you're about to fire them.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Camel coat, white shirt, silver ring. Pure power, no effort.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: All black every day is not a personality. It's a uniform.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Your glow-up is the soft heart behind the armour.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Soften your eyes when you listen. That's it. Huge difference.

chapters.aura: Your aura is a polished jewel catching light. Sin carries a refined, elegant presence that people notice instantly, even if they can't name exactly what's special. You read as stylish, sensitive and a little bit precious, in the good sense: someone with taste, standards and a quiet sparkle. Your glow is about detail and quality. A perfectly chosen ring, a beautiful turn of phrase, the way you hold a cup of coffee. People often find you intriguing and slightly out of reach. The glow-up for you isn't about polishing more. You're already polished. It's about letting a bit of imperfection and warmth show, so people feel invited closer instead of admiring you from behind glass.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: elegant, put-together, possibly aloof. People assume you have great taste and high standards, and they're right. Some feel slightly nervous around you, worried they won't measure up. Once they know you, they discover a sensitive, witty, deeply loyal person who notices beautiful small things. The misreading comes from that polish. Some think you're cold, judgmental or high-maintenance, when you're actually just private and careful with your feelings. To be read more accurately, show your humour early, compliment others generously, and let people see you a little messy sometimes, laughing too hard, admitting something embarrassing. You'll still sparkle. But people will feel the warmth, not just the shine.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is refined Metal: pearl white, champagne, soft silver, dove grey, icy pastels like lavender and powder blue. These look elegant and luminous on you, like moonlight on silk. Earth supports Metal, so soft beige, nude and stone tones make wonderful bases. Deep Water colours, navy and midnight, add a sophisticated, mysterious edge for evenings. Jewellery is your playground: delicate silver, pearls, a single perfect stone. Be careful with very loud, warm colours like bright orange or chaotic prints. They can drown your refined glow and make you look uncomfortable. Your best palette feels like an expensive perfume bottle, clean, luminous and quietly special.
chapters.style: Your style is elegant minimalism with jewellery as the star. Clean silhouettes, quality fabrics, silk, fine knit, crisp cotton, and accessories that look carefully chosen. You look incredible in monochrome outfits with one stunning detail. Think slip skirts, tailored trousers, fine-gauge sweaters, a structured small bag. You understand fit and finish better than most souls. The trap is perfectionism: overthinking every outfit, feeling uncomfortable unless everything is flawless, avoiding photos on "bad" days. Allow some ease. A slightly messy bun, a relaxed weekend look, an imperfect candid shot. Your best photo is soft daylight, close-up, with jewellery visible and a real smile, not your controlled one.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the approachable jewel. Imagine the elegant webtoon character everyone thinks is untouchable, until one chapter shows her laughing with crumbs on her face, and readers fall for her completely. The shift for you is warmth and spontaneity. Say yes to a plan without checking if your outfit is perfect. Share something you're proud of without downplaying it. Give compliments as freely as you notice flaws. Laugh loudly once in a while. Let someone see you without the polish. Your elegance is real and it isn't going anywhere. Adding warmth just turns it from something people admire into something people feel lucky to be close to.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you feel criticized, overlooked or under pressure to be perfect. You start overanalyzing your appearance, your messages, every small thing you said, and your glow turns anxious. You might withdraw, look tense or go icy-polite. Your style can become either obsessively perfect or completely abandoned. The reset is gentle and sensory. Clean and tidy your space, because order calms you. Take a long, unhurried bath or shower with something that smells beautiful. Put on your favourite piece of jewellery even if you're staying home. Spend time with someone who adores you exactly as you are. Unfollow accounts that make you compare yourself. A jewel shines brightest when it's handled gently.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Sin, your aura is a jewel. Elegant, luminous, people notice you without knowing why.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: And then they're scared to talk to you. You look like you'd judge their shoes.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Pearl, champagne, soft silver. You look like expensive perfume.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: You also changed your outfit four times this morning. For a grocery run.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Your glow-up is warmth. Let people see you laugh with crumbs on your face.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Perfect is boring. Post the candid one.

chapters.aura: Your aura is the open ocean: vast, deep and impossible to fully see. Im carries a big, free-spirited, intelligent presence that draws people in like a tide. You read as worldly, curious and slightly unpredictable, the person who just got back from somewhere interesting and is already planning the next thing. Your glow has movement and depth. People sense there's a lot going on under the surface. Your energy can fill a room, but in a relaxed, rolling way rather than a loud one. The glow-up for you isn't being more mysterious. It's adding a sense of anchor, so your expansive energy reads as grounded and trustworthy, not just exciting.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: interesting, adventurous, a bit hard to pin down. People assume you're well-travelled, open-minded and easygoing, and you usually are. You come across as someone with great stories and big ideas. The misreading: some think you're unreliable or not fully present, because your mind is always moving. Others think you're too cool to care, when you're actually just absorbing everything. You might seem distracted in conversations you're genuinely enjoying. To be read more accurately, show a little consistency. Follow up on what someone told you last time, keep small promises, put your phone face down. Your depth is fascinating. Grounding it makes people trust that the ocean has a shore.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is deep Water: navy, midnight blue, ink, charcoal, black, deep teal. These make you look mysterious, intelligent and effortlessly cool, like a night swim. Metal feeds Water in the five elements, so white, silver and soft grey add clarity and freshness. A navy outfit with silver jewellery is your aura in its best form. For warmth and approachability, add a little Wood: sea green, olive, or a natural linen tone. Be careful with too many heavy earth tones like mustard or brown, which can make your fluid energy feel stuck. Your colours should feel like the sea at different times of day: deep, shifting and always alive.
chapters.style: Your style is effortless cool with a well-travelled edge. Relaxed tailoring, fluid trousers, long coats, oversized shirts, pieces you picked up in different cities. Layers that move suit you, especially in fabrics that drape. You look great in an outfit that could go from a museum to a night out without changing. The trap is looking scattered or careless, too many vibes in one outfit, or so relaxed it reads unbothered rather than cool. Choose a consistent foundation, dark colours and clean shapes, then add one travel-souvenir detail. Hair with natural movement, minimal fuss. Your best photo is near water or in moody evening light, mid-movement, looking toward the horizon.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the anchored adventurer. Picture the free-spirited K-drama character who finally commits to something and becomes even more magnetic because of it. The shift for you is consistency. Show up when you said you would. Finish one project you started. Keep a small ritual, the same café on Sunday mornings, a weekly call with a friend. Let people rely on you. It doesn't cage your freedom. It makes it meaningful. Keep your curiosity, your big questions and your appetite for new places. Just add some depth to the waves. People are drawn to the ocean. They fall in love with the coastline they can return to.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you feel trapped, bored or overwhelmed by too many directions at once. Either you become restless and scattered, starting ten things and finishing none, or you go still and flat, scrolling for hours, uninspired. Your style drifts into whatever's nearest, and you look unfocused. The reset is fresh input with a gentle anchor. Go somewhere you've never been, even if it's a new neighbourhood. Spend time near water, a river, a lake, the sea. Read something that expands your mind. Then do one grounding thing: tidy your space, make a simple plan for the week, finish one small task. Oceans need both currents and depth. Give yourself both.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Im, your aura is the ocean. Deep, curious, people get pulled into your orbit.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Then you leave mid-conversation because you saw a cool dog.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Navy and silver on you? Mysterious, smart, slightly dangerous. Love it.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Your outfit has four countries and three moods in it. Choose.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Your glow-up is the anchored adventurer. Freedom plus follow-through.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Show up on time once. People will think you've been replaced.

chapters.aura: Your aura is morning mist over a lake: soft, dreamy and quietly enchanting. Gye carries a gentle, intuitive presence that makes people feel calmer and a little more curious. You read as artistic, sensitive and mysterious, the person who seems to notice things no one else does. Your glow is subtle and atmospheric. It doesn't hit people all at once, it settles over them slowly, until they realize they can't stop thinking about you. There's a quiet magic in your energy, like a rainy day in a good bookshop. The glow-up for you isn't becoming louder or more visible overnight. It's adding enough clarity to the mist that people can see you clearly, and remember the shape of you, not just the feeling.
chapters.how-people-read-you: First impression: soft, shy, intriguing. People assume you're creative and emotionally deep, and they're right. Some feel protective of you, others feel a little mystified. The misreading is that people often underestimate your strength. They think you're fragile when you're actually incredibly resilient, rain wears down mountains over time. Some also think you're distant or uninterested, when you're simply observing before engaging. To be read more accurately, share your perspective sooner, even if your voice is quiet. Make eye contact a beat longer. Let your humour out, because you're often funnier than people expect. Your mystery is appealing, but your clarity is what helps people truly connect with you.
chapters.colors: Your home palette is soft Water: misty blue, slate, smoky grey, deep navy, ink and soft black. These look dreamy and atmospheric on you, like a watercolour painting of the sea. Metal feeds Water, so silver, pearl and soft white add luminosity, especially near your face. Lavender and soft lilac bring out your gentle, romantic side. For clarity and a bit of life, add Wood tones like sage or eucalyptus green. Be careful with very strong, bright colours like neon or tomato red in large amounts. They can overwhelm your subtle aura and make you look uncomfortable. Your colours should feel like rain on a window: soft, cool and quietly beautiful.
chapters.style: Your style is dreamy minimalist with an artistic touch. Flowing fabrics, soft layers, oversized knits, long skirts, a beautiful coat for rainy days. You look great in outfits with gentle movement and subtle texture. Vintage and handmade pieces, a ring from a market, a hand-knitted scarf, suit your soul. The trap is blurring into the background, so many soft, muted pieces that your style disappears. Add one clear focal point: a silver statement earring, a deep blue coat, a sharp shoe. Hair soft and natural, makeup dewy and fresh. Your best photo is in soft, diffused light, a rainy window, a foggy street, a dim café, looking slightly away with a quiet, knowing expression.
chapters.vibe: Your glow-up vibe is the mist that clears into a rainbow. Think of the quiet, mysterious webtoon character whose backstory turns out to be the heart of the whole series. The shift for you is self-expression. Share your art, your writing, your playlists, your strange beautiful thoughts with more people. Speak up in a conversation where you'd usually stay quiet. Wear the one bold piece that makes you feel brave. Let people see your humour and your opinions, not just your gentleness. Keep your sensitivity, it's a true gift. Just pair it with a little confidence, and your soft aura becomes unforgettable rather than easy to miss.
chapters.aura-dims: Your aura dims when you've absorbed too many other people's emotions. You become foggy, withdrawn and a little lost. You might stay inside, scroll endlessly, avoid messages and dress in whatever's softest and darkest. Your glow fades into grey. The reset is gentle clearing. Spend time alone in a calm, quiet space. Listen to music that matches your mood, then music that lifts it. Write down everything you're feeling, without editing. Take a walk in the rain or near water. Wear something light, silver or pearl to brighten your energy. Then reach out to one safe person. Mist always lifts eventually. You just need a little quiet, and a little light, to let it go.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Gye, your aura is morning mist. Dreamy, gentle, people feel calmer around you.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: They also forget you're in the room. You disappear on purpose, don't you?

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Misty blue, pearl, a long rainy-day coat. You look like a watercolour.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: So many soft greys you've become a cloud. Add one sharp thing.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Your glow-up is clarity. Let people see the shape of you.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Speak up once in the group chat. Not a sticker. Actual words.

by_element_balance.too_much_wood: Too much Wood gives your aura lots of drive and upward energy, but it can read as restless or intense, always busy, always growing. Your style may lean practical and outdoorsy, sometimes at the expense of polish. Balance it with Metal touches: a crisp white shirt, silver jewellery, cleaner lines, one tailored piece. Declutter your wardrobe so what remains feels intentional. Your glow is strongest when your ambition looks calm, like a tall tree that doesn't need to prove it's growing.
by_element_balance.missing_wood: Missing Wood means your aura can lack a sense of freshness and new beginnings. You might stick to the same outfits for years or feel unsure about trying new styles. Bring in Wood: greens, botanical prints, natural fabrics like linen and cotton, plants in your space. Try one new style element each month, a different silhouette, a new accessory, a new hair clip. Growth looks good on you. Let your style evolve a little, the way spring changes a garden.
by_element_balance.too_much_fire: Too much Fire makes your aura bright, bold and sometimes overwhelming. You might gravitate to loud colours, big statements and high-energy looks that occasionally feel like too much at once. Balance it with Water: navy, deep blue, black accents, calmer silhouettes. Choose one statement per outfit instead of five. Let some quiet into your presence too, listening more, moving slower. Your glow is already strong. Cooling it slightly makes it look richer and more confident.
by_element_balance.missing_fire: Missing Fire means your aura can feel understated, sometimes so understated that people overlook you. You might default to neutrals and avoid anything that draws attention. Bring in Fire: a red lip, a coral scarf, warm gold jewellery, a little shimmer. Seek out sunlight in photos and in life. Let yourself be seen in small ways: post the photo, wear the bright thing, laugh openly. Visibility is a skill, and it looks lovely on you when you allow it.
by_element_balance.too_much_earth: Too much Earth gives you a grounded, warm aura that can slide into heavy or overly practical. Your wardrobe may be comfortable but samey, lots of beige, brown and safe basics. Balance it with Wood: fresh greens, lighter fabrics, a playful print, something that moves when you walk. Try one unexpected piece. Rearrange your space for a fresh feeling. Your stability is beautiful. A little lightness on top keeps it from looking stuck.
by_element_balance.missing_earth: Missing Earth can make your aura feel scattered or ungrounded, lots of ideas, many style moods, not much consistency. Your outfits may change wildly depending on your mood. Bring in Earth: camel, beige, warm brown, ochre, and solid basics like a good coat and reliable shoes. Build a small capsule wardrobe you can trust. Ceramics, wood and warm lighting at home help too. When your foundation is steady, your creativity looks intentional instead of chaotic.
by_element_balance.too_much_metal: Too much Metal gives your aura sharpness and polish that can tip into cold or severe. Your style may be immaculate but a little untouchable: very clean lines, lots of black, white and grey, everything controlled. Balance it with Fire: warm colours near your face, soft textures, a smile that comes sooner. Let one thing be imperfect on purpose, rolled sleeves, tousled hair, a playful accessory. Precision is your strength. Warmth makes it inviting.
by_element_balance.missing_metal: Missing Metal can make your aura feel soft but a little undefined. People like you, but they might not remember your style clearly. Bring in Metal: silver jewellery, crisp white, sharp tailoring, clean shoes, a structured bag. Edit your wardrobe so every piece earns its place. A clear signature, the same ring, the same scent, a consistent colour, gives your look definition. Clarity doesn't make you colder. It makes you memorable.
by_element_balance.too_much_water: Too much Water gives your aura depth and mystery, but it can read as distant, moody or hard to reach. You might hide in dark colours and oversized layers. Balance it with Earth: warm neutrals near your face, structured pieces, a grounded silhouette. Add a little Fire too, a coral or rose accent, to bring warmth. Let people see your expression clearly. Your mystery is magnetic. A bit of warmth makes it feel welcoming, not unreachable.
by_element_balance.missing_water: Missing Water means your aura can feel busy and bright without much depth or calm. You might always be on, always moving, with little stillness. Bring in Water: navy, midnight blue, black, flowing fabrics, a more relaxed silhouette. Create quiet moments in your day and let them show in your style, softer textures, fewer accessories. Water by your bed and slow evenings help your energy settle. Depth looks good on you. Give it some room.
